headline: Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse Erupt in Ferocious Clashes
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, the lull along the eastern front has shattered as Stlican Shelf erupted into intense combat, recording eleven base events in the past two hours across Breaker Town and The Pale House. Weathered Expanse continues to bear the heaviest fighting along the line, logging eight base exchanges and over fifteen hundred casualties in the same period around Shattered Advance and Wightwalk. To the west and center, Linn of Mercy and Callahan's Passage remain fiercely contested, adding six and four base events respectively while tallying heavy losses at The Long Whine and The Latch. Viper Pit and Marban Hollow also saw sharp flare-ups, with five combined base actions centered on Blackthroat and Mox. Conversely, Dead Lands has fallen quiet with no territory shifting over the last two hours, while Stonecradle and Farranac Coast endure steady attrition without base flips. The remaining rearward and island sectors report negligible action as frontlines convulse under renewed pressure.
